Conceptual relationship line, not an engineering centreline.

design_east_west_connector_count.formula: count(features where network_role is an east_west or area connector)

assumptions: Conceptual network; requires right-of-way and field verification.

enterprise_commute_demand_baseline.formula: stratified_count(enterprise commute records) over a dated weekday/weekend sample
enterprise_commute_demand_baseline.reason: No project-specific enterprise demand register or consented aggregation has been completed.

resident_daily_trip_access_index.formula: weighted_access score for daily services by resident group and time window
resident_daily_trip_access_index.reason: No stratified resident baseline, route audit or service survey is available.

employer_multimodal_trip_rate.formula: non-single-occupancy-auto trips / all observed employee commute trips
employer_multimodal_trip_rate.reason: No employer travel survey or count has been completed.

parking_occupancy_by_window_ratio.formula: occupied regulated curb/parking spaces / observed spaces by time window
parking_occupancy_by_window_ratio.reason: Current parking inventory, occupancy, turnover and enforcement records are not included.

curb_time_window_compliance_ratio.formula: served curb events within booked start/end and cleared by the end time / all observed booked events
curb_time_window_compliance_ratio.reason: No curb booking, clearing or exception log exists for this submission area.

first_last_mile_transfer_reliability.formula: transfers completed within the approved connection buffer / observed transfers
first_last_mile_transfer_reliability.reason: No station-level arrival, departure, walking and waiting observations are available.

accessible_route_completion_ratio.formula: verified accessible trips completed without obstruction or forced detour / sampled accessible trips
accessible_route_completion_ratio.reason: No field audit of slopes, crossings, tactile paving, signals or obstruction continuity is available.

peak_curb_conflict_rate.formula: count of observed curb conflicts / observed curb-service events * 100
peak_curb_conflict_rate.reason: No human-counted curb conflict sample or incident taxonomy is available.

mobility_service_complaint_closure_hours.formula: median time from complaint receipt to documented closure or accountable status update
mobility_service_complaint_closure_hours.reason: No mobility-specific complaint log, owner or service-level agreement is available.

workplace_ev_charge_supply_gap_ratio.formula: peak workplace charging demand minus available employer supply / peak demand
workplace_ev_charge_supply_gap_ratio.reason: No local charging inventory or employer demand sample is available; comparative research is not a local baseline.
